shareDescription.descriptive: We will review what the parties propose on advanced AI, with sources.

quotes.title: Checked quotes
quotes.body: Every rating shows its sources, and every quote is checked against the original document.

history.title: Changes in the open

corrections.title: Public corrections
corrections.body: If we get something wrong, we fix it and record it in a public log.

errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
errors.forbidden: You aren't allowed to do that.
errors.stale: This has changed since you opened it, or can't be done right now. Reload and try again.
errors.linked: Something this refers to has gone, or something still refers to it.
errors.limit: That limit has been reached. Try again later.
errors.notFound: That isn't there any more. Reload the page.
errors.lastCountryAdmin: This is the site's only country admin. Give someone else that role first.
errors.notMember: Only members of the site can be given a role directly. Anyone else needs an invitation.
errors.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Sign in with the email address your invitation was sent to.
signIn.noAccount: Accounts are by invitation only. If you need one, ask your team's coordinator.

challenge.title: Two-step verification
challenge.intro: Enter the 6-digit code your authenticator app shows for this account.
challenge.backupIntro: Enter one of the backup codes you saved when you set up two-step verification. Each one works once.

enrol.title: Set up two-step verification
enrol.intro: Every account needs a second step: a code from an authenticator app on your phone, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis or 2FAS.
enrol.scanTitle: Add this account to your app
enrol.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
enrol.qrLabel: QR code to add this account to an authenticator app
enrol.manual: If you can't scan it, add the account by hand with this key:
enrol.codeHint: Enter the 6-digit code the app now shows, to check it works.
enrol.backupIntro: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. Keep them somewhere safe, such as a password manager: they won't be shown again.

setPassword.title: Set your password
setPassword.intro: Choose the password for your account. This link works once, for an hour.
setPassword.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A few unrelated words make a strong one that is easy to remember.
setPassword.done: Sign in with it now. You will then set up two-step verification.
setPassword.missing: This page needs the link you were given. Open that link instead.

home.title: Your sites
home.noTenants: You don't have access to any site yet. Your team's coordinator can give you a role.

errors.invalidCredentials: The email address or password is not right.
errors.invalidCode: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.locked: Too many wrong codes. Wait a few minutes, then sign in again.
errors.tooManyCodes: Too many wrong codes for this sign-in. Please sign in again.
errors.expired: This sign-in has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.invalidLink: This link no longer works: it works once, for an hour. Ask for a new one.
errors.passwordsDiffer: The two passwords are not the same.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again later.

sites.platformAdmin: As a platform admin, you see every site.

dashboard.platformAdmin: You are a platform admin: you may do here what every role may.
dashboard.notPublic: This site isn't public yet: nothing of it shows on the public site until a platform admin turns it on.
dashboard.membersIntro: Who has access to this site, and with which roles.
dashboard.queuesLater: Your work queues (drafts, reviews, reports) will show here once cells can be edited.

members.title: Members
members.intro: Everyone with access to this site and the roles they hold. A role that is removed stops working on the member's next request.
members.manageIntro: To give someone new access, they need an invitation. Invitations aren't available yet.
members.name: Name
members.onlyCountryAdmin: The site's only country admin: give the role to someone else before removing it.
members.confirmBody: Remove the {role} role from {name}? They lose what it allows on their next request.
members.confirmSelf: Remove your own {role} role? You lose what it allows straight away.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.
